violations.issue: Some images have overly verbose alt text (exceeding 125 characters) which can be overwhelming for screen reader users. Alt text should be concise.
violations.example: alt="Mobile emergency restoration services Brisbane - IICRC Master Restorer Phill McGurk 24/7 water damage fire damage mould remediation accessible on iPhone Android smartphones tablets - instant emergency contact 1300 309 361"
violations.recommendation: Reduce alt text to essential information: 'Mobile emergency restoration services - call 1300 309 361'. Move detailed information to caption or surrounding text.

violations.issue: Services dropdown menu is primarily mouse-driven. Keyboard users cannot easily access dropdown without clicking.
violations.recommendation: Ensure dropdown can be opened with Enter/Space key and navigated with arrow keys. Add onKeyDown handlers for keyboard navigation.

violations.issue: Links with 'Learn More' or 'View Coverage' text lack context when read out of context by screen readers.
violations.recommendation: Add aria-label with full context: 'Learn more about mould remediation services' or use visually-hidden text for additional context.

violations.issue: Form labels exist but lack explicit association with error messages. No aria-describedby for validation hints.
violations.recommendation: Add aria-describedby to connect inputs with helper text and error messages. Implement aria-invalid for invalid fields.

violations.issue: Text on blue background (text-blue-200 on blue-900 gradient) may not meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Measured approximately 3.8:1.
violations.recommendation: Change text-blue-200 to white or text-blue-50 for better contrast. Test with browser DevTools Contrast Checker.

violations.issue: Input placeholder text using text-gray-700 on white background may not meet minimum contrast for placeholder text.
violations.recommendation: Use text-gray-600 or darker for placeholder text to ensure 4.5:1 minimum contrast.

violations.issue: Focus indicator on dropdown button may not meet 3:1 contrast ratio against adjacent colors.
violations.recommendation: Add explicit focus-visible styles with high-contrast outline: focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-600

violations.issue: Several interactive elements lack visible focus indicators, particularly custom-styled buttons and links.
examples: app/page.tsx line 662 - Large phone button lacks distinct focus state
components/EmergencyCTA.tsx lines 28-38 - Floating CTA has no focus indicator
violations.recommendation: Add consistent focus-visible styles across all interactive elements. Use design system focus-ring utility.

violations.issue: Phone number formatted inconsistently: '1300 309 361' vs '1300309361' in different locations.
violations.recommendation: Standardize phone number display format across all pages for consistent user experience.

critical.issue: Viewport meta tag allows excessive zoom (maximumScale: 5)
critical.recommendation: While allowing zoom is good for accessibility, maximumScale of 5 is excessive. Recommend maximumScale: 2 or 3 for better mobile UX while maintaining accessibility.
critical.impact: Users may accidentally over-zoom causing navigation difficulties.

critical.issue: Missing aria-labels on mobile menu toggle
critical.current: aria-label present but aria-expanded not synchronized
critical.recommendation: Ensure aria-expanded accurately reflects menu state. Currently set correctly.
critical.impact: Screen reader users may not know if menu is open or closed.

high.issue: Touch targets below 44x44px minimum on some text links
high.recommendation: Add padding to footer links to achieve minimum 44x44px touch target: py-2.5 px-2 classes.
high.note: This is AAA criterion, but critical for mobile emergency service site.

high.issue: Dropdown menu items on mobile may be difficult to tap accurately
high.recommendation: Increase py-2 to py-3 on mobile dropdown items to ensure 44x44px minimum.

high.issue: Modal drawer swipe gesture not implemented
high.recommendation: Consider adding swipe-to-close gesture for mobile menu drawer for better mobile UX (not WCAG requirement but best practice).

high.issue: Fixed emergency banner may obscure content on small mobile devices
high.current: Fixed bottom positioning with no safe area consideration
high.recommendation: Add safe-area-inset-bottom for iOS devices: pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]

medium.issue: Form inputs on mobile could be larger for better usability
medium.recommendation: Already meets 44x44px minimum. Could increase to py-4 on mobile for enhanced usability.

medium.issue: Mobile navigation items spacing could be improved
medium.recommendation: Current spacing is adequate. No action required.

issues.details: Images have alt text but some are overly verbose. 86 alt attributes found across app pages, indicating good coverage but quality needs review.
Multiple contrast issues identified. Primary concern: text-blue-200 on blue-900 background, gray-700 placeholders.
Responsive design implemented with proper breakpoints. Content adapts well to different viewport sizes.
Some UI elements rely on color alone. Add icons or patterns for color-blind users.
